properties.description:
Completed correction after user review, 2026-10-20

Every instance exposes its component type's complete property declarations. Property declarations no longer have required or hidden flags. Optionality belongs to the value's data type; an absent optional value is explicitly displayed as Not set. Nullable values and empty strings remain distinct from absence.

Implemented and verified
- Removed required/hidden declarations, reflection metadata and suppression behavior throughout the engine and consumers. Non-optional value types reject missing values, and undeclared component keys remain rejected.
- Native model compilation emits optional value types for optional values. Validation, query traversal, planning and preview editing use those types.
- Node editor always presents the complete declared property list, including read-only properties whose values are absent. Property name, help, type and read-only status remain above the value.
- The reported transition graph://planning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b/entries/f8bea499-6091-4dfc-b3cf-0c7b699e9d3b.json now shows all ten Activity board entry properties, including Description: Not set. Transition belongs to the separate Task transition component.
- Verified optional enum choices in Activity cards and clearing optional preview values in the running preview. Exact regressions cover both.
- Rebuilt and restarted the application; inspected the reported node through the live service and GUI.

Earlier accepted annotations retained
5. Activity board entry structure is defined by its component type, with no Transition property.
6. Updated by is a non-optional user/agent reference. The previously authorized creator-to-updater conversion covered 2,588 records, preserving existing updater attribution and content timestamps.
7. Two-user acknowledgement regression recordings preserve content update timestamps/attribution and avoid an acknowledgement loop.
8. Attention is displayed as AttentionTracking.
Prior implementation and data-conversion evidence remains attached as Component consistency and updater verification 2026-10-20.json.

Validation
Final build passed; type checks report zero violations across 1,069 authored files. Model checkpoint: 45/45; rebuilt catalog: 5/5; affected engine, schema, planning, preview and browser checks pass. Full browser run initially passed 263/272; all nine failing cases subsequently passed focused reruns. The full application run still has four previously tracked Windows cancellation/deadline timing failures. This is not a claim that the whole suite is green.

Commit: ccc4f51a9907d59e44196312451c7a21c652fefc
New evidence: Complete property structure verification 2026-10-20.json, including before/after recordings, validation results and live-node verification.

Separate Idea input: graph://planning-26535745-4644-4770-af7c-1980c773377b/entries/05aff937-7fd0-4b3f-b426-764df8ce7914.json — Merge property and component. This preserves the discussion about named typed property positions versus independently identifiable component instances. The merger is not implemented.
properties.title: Enforce consistent activity component properties and required updater attribution
